title: GG 9 · Dashboard: Global Genius needs your action, and downtime
walkthroughSteps: The dashboard lists only the Global Genius problems you have to fix: one row per broken item, each saying what broke and linking to its own fix.
Finance-owned failures and items waiting for Global Genius are not red rows. Waiting items are counted in the downtime banner.
Before planned downtime and while Global Genius is down, one banner in the financial closure banner's spot says there is nothing to do.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dashboard · Two failures on two claims
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** Global Genius: needs your action, count 2. Row 1: CLM-2024-001, "Payment to Dirk Haas not booked: the payee's bank details don't match what Global Genius has for them.", link Fix payment. Row 2: CLM-2024-003, "Indemnity reserve for GBF Logistics GmbH not booked: ...", link Fix reserve.

**Try:** Press Fix payment: the Payments list of CLM-2024-001 opens with payment 123456-3 open, scrolled to, and Global Genius's reason shown under it. Go back and press Fix reserve: the Reserves list of CLM-2024-003 opens with that reserve open.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The PO / BO answers talk about a red triangle on the claim. The prototype lists one row per broken item, not per claim, so every row links straight to its own fix and a claim with two failures gets two rows (critique 4 in docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md). DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-1 in src/app/core/models/gg-dashboard.model.ts. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** Count 8. The first 5 rows, then "Show 3 more". Rows cover payments, reserves, a recovery (Fix recovery) and a section ("Section ... not booked: BKG-5021 ...", Retry on claim).

**Try:** Press Show 3 more: all 8 rows show.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The PO / BO answers ask for pagination in the widget. The prototype shows the first 5 rows and "Show N more", the dashboard's own pattern (recovery-potential-panel.ts). Downtime items no longer go in the list, so it stays short (critique 2). DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-1. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann, while Global Genius is unavailable.

**You see:** Yellow banner at the top: "Global Genius is unavailable. 3 items are waiting and will be sent automatically when it's back. Nothing to do." The 3 waiting items are not in the list. The list shows only the 1 item you have to fix (Payment to Elke Dorn).

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The PO / BO answers keep the waiting claims flagged as well as the banner. The prototype does not show waiting items as red rows: they are only counted in the banner, because red on every claim during downtime looks like 50 problems and is really zero actions (critique 1). Not built yet: the "Waiting for Global Genius" (not red) status on the claim's own lists; the Payments list still says "Couldn't be booked" for these items. DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-1. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Source: Review call questions (James) and PO / BO answers, email 2026-11-18; UX basis docs/ux/gg-dashboard.md.

**Opens:** Dashboard as Mara Mustermann.

**You see:** No rows: "Everything is booked in Global Genius." The payment Finance is fixing and the reserve that already failed a second time are not listed. On the claim's Payments and Reserves lists they say "With Finance".

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** The prototype leaves Finance-owned failures out of the handler's list, because the handler can't fix them (critique 6). The claim still shows "With Finance". A failure that was already sent again and failed again counts as Finance's (effectiveOwner in gg-booking.model.ts). DESIGN DECISION GG-DASH-1. Treated as `done`, pending product sign-off.
